density_fields.name: 2M++ Carrick et al. v1.0 preprocessed smoothed density field
density_fields.mask_or_edge_policy: finite cube; interpolation outside box is NaN; covariance sub-select C[I,I]; smoothing uses nearest-edge mode; coverage audited by c33_density_coverage_by_scale.csv

sn_table_patch.redshift_column_for_distance: zHD plus zHEL only if using Pantheon+ distance convention externally
sn_table_patch.residual_column: MU_SH0ES residual against fixed H0_geom background OR externally supplied standardized Hubble residual; must be finalized before C3.2
sn_table_patch.uncertainty_column: MU_SH0ES_ERR_DIAG for diagnostics; STAT+SYS covariance is authoritative for production

nuisance_controls_patch.peculiar_velocity: VPEC,VPECERR plus z-cut robustness suite z>0.01,z>0.02,z>0.03
nuisance_controls_patch.metallicity: optional external table; omission test required if absent
nuisance_controls_patch.sSFR: optional external table; omission test required if absent
nuisance_controls_patch.dust: MWEBV available; host dust requires external table or omission test
